events.title: Supreme Court Constitution Bench hears arguments on digital privacy and civic transparency
events.summary: A five-judge Constitution bench presided over arguments addressing digital personal data protection frameworks, public disclosure compliance, and citizen safeguards across government platforms.
events.authorities: The Solicitor General assured the bench that updated regulatory compliance guidelines would be submitted within two weeks.

events.title: Commission for Air Quality Management enforces Stage-III GRAP as AQI enters severe zone
events.summary: Stringent restrictions on non-essential construction and strict vehicular emission controls were activated as winter meteorological conditions and stubble burning pushed the air quality index above 400 in parts of Delhi-NCR.
events.authorities: Delhi Traffic Police set up round-the-clock checkpoints along border entries to inspect commercial goods vehicles.

events.title: Reserve Bank of India maintains liquidity buffer amid robust festive retail demand
events.summary: Financial markets noted steady foreign portfolio inflows and strong manufacturing PMI readings as capital expenditure in core infrastructure sectors showed double-digit year-on-year growth.
events.authorities: The RBI Governor stated that headline inflation remains on track toward the medium-term 4% target while credit growth stays resilient.

events.title: ISRO tests next-generation semi-cryogenic engine for Gaganyaan and heavy-lift missions
events.summary: Scientists at ISRO's propulsion facility completed long-duration hot tests on the advanced semi-cryogenic rocket stage, marking a major milestone for India's upcoming human spaceflight program.
events.authorities: ISRO mission director confirmed all propulsion parameters, pressure balances, and combustion dynamics operated within expected design limits.

events.title: Resident doctors and civic groups hold candlelight march demanding enhanced hospital safety
events.summary: Thousands of medical interns, nursing staff, and university students marched peacefully demanding prompt installation of biometric access controls, dedicated security patrols, and duty-room infrastructure across state-run medical colleges.
events.authorities: Health department officials stated that 80% of mandated CCTV and panic button installations have now been completed across teaching hospitals.

events.title: Hyderabad Metro Phase 2 airport express line civil work begins
events.summary: Pre-construction piling and utility shifting began along the 31-kilometer corridor designed to connect the IT hub directly with Rajiv Gandhi International Airport in under 22 minutes.
events.authorities: Telangana Municipal Administration officials announced a 36-month completion timeline with eco-friendly viaduct designs.

events.title: IMD issues Northeast Monsoon advisory for coastal Tamil Nadu with widespread moderate rainfall
events.summary: The Regional Meteorological Centre flagged active low-pressure systems over the Bay of Bengal bringing sustained rainfall to Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram, and delta districts.
events.authorities: Greater Chennai Corporation activated automated water pumping stations and 24/7 disaster control helplines.

events.title: Farmer unions hold tractor convention urging legal guarantee on MSP and crop insurance reforms
events.summary: Representatives of several farmer organizations gathered to submit memorandums to district collectors seeking statutory minimum support prices across 23 notified crops and rapid compensation for unseasonal hail damage.
events.authorities: District administration facilitated peaceful assembly and designated traffic diversions along national highway segments.

events.title: Ganga Expressway final paving reaches 90% completion ahead of trial runs
events.summary: The 594-kilometer high-speed corridor connecting Meerut to Prayagraj via 12 districts completed critical bridge spans over the Ramganga and Garra rivers.
events.authorities: UP Expressway Industrial Development Authority (UPEIDA) confirmed emergency airstrip stretches are ready for civil aviation certification.

events.title: Jammu & Kashmir Police launch tech-driven highway surveillance grid
events.summary: Advanced automated number plate recognition (ANPR) cameras and drone monitoring units were integrated along National Highway 44 to enhance transit security and commercial traffic efficiency.
events.authorities: J&K Traffic and Security branches confirmed over 120 smart monitoring poles are now operational from Jammu to Srinagar.

events.title: GIFT City IFSC registers record cross-border transaction volume and new foreign bank branches
events.summary: India's premier international financial services centre reported a 45% annual increase in banking asset book size, driven by structured trade finance, bullion trade, and aircraft leasing units.
events.authorities: IFSCA chairman highlighted streamlined single-window clearances for global fintech startups.

events.title: New six-lane bridge over Brahmaputra linking Guwahati to North Guwahati enters final deck placement
events.summary: Engineering teams completed the installation of the main cable-stayed steel girders across the river, shortening daily commute times between the two banks from 75 minutes to just 12 minutes.
events.authorities: Assam Public Works Department affirmed that full load testing will commence next month.
